metadata.title: Oddbeam AI Models — Video & Image Generation
metadata.description: All AI video and image models on Oddbeam, one account, one credit pool. Compare duration, resolution, and credit cost per model, then generate in the studio.

intro: One Oddbeam account unlocks every AI model: video and image generation share the same credit pool, with no separate subscriptions. Pick a model by task below, or switch anytime inside the studio.

params.seedance-2-5: Up to 30s per run, 480P–1080P, accepts text/image/video/audio input
params.seedance-2-0: Up to 15s per run, 480P–1080P, accepts text/image/video input
params.seedance-2-0-fast: Up to 15s per run, 480P–1080P, faster Seedance 2.0 variant
params.seedance-2-0-mini: Up to 15s per run, 480P–1080P, lightweight Seedance 2.0
params.veo-3-1-premium: 8s per run, up to 4K, native audio, last-frame support
params.veo-3-1-lite: 8s per run, last-frame and multi-image references
params.kling-2-5: Up to 10s per run, enhanced motion and physics, no audio
params.kling-2-1-master: 10s per run, accepts text and image input
params.kling-2-1-pro: 10s per run, last-frame support, image input only
params.wan-3-0: Up to 30s per run, accepts document/webpage input and multimodal references
params.wan-3-0-prime: Up to 30s per run, first/last frame and multimodal references
params.minimax-h3: Up to 15s per run, last-frame and multi-image references, omni-modal input/output
params.minimax-h3-max-turbo: 5–15s per run, last-frame support, turbo speed
params.gemini-omni-flash-1-1: 4–10s per run, accepts text, first/last frame, video, audio, and character references
params.gemini-omni: 4–10s per run, accepts text, image, video, audio, and character references
params.ltx-2-5-fast: 2–20s per run, last-frame support, fast generation
params.pixverse-v6: 1–15s per run, HD output, last-frame, multi-image, and multi-shot support
params.grok-imagine-video: About 5s per run, accepts text and image input
params.runway-gen-4: 10s per run, accepts text and image input
params.gpt-images-2-5-flare: 5+ reference images, multi-image input, HD output, accurate text rendering
params.seedream-4: Accepts text and image input, generates matched image sets in one run
params.seedream-5-lite: Research-aware lightweight image model, accepts text and image input
params.nano-banana-pro: Search-grounded, 14 reference images, 5 consistent characters, HD output
params.nano-banana-2: Multi-turn local editing without drift, accepts text and image input
params.flux-kontext-pro: Context-aware local editing, accepts text and image input
params.grok-imagine-image: Point-and-edit local editing, 5 reference images, smart resize

audio_entry.name: AI Music Generator
audio_entry.description: Generate music tracks from a prompt in the same studio

guide: For long takes, pick Seedance 2.5 or Wan 3.0 (up to 30s per run). For 4K with native audio, pick Veo 3.1 Premium. For high-volume budgets, pick Seedance 2.0 Mini or Wan 3.0. To edit product photos, pick Nano Banana 2 or Flux Kontext Max. For matched image sets, pick Seedream 4.0. For posters where text must be right, pick GPT Images 2.5.
cta_text: Open the studio and start generating
